title: A Benchmark for Text-to-Image Alignment and Kernelized Direct Preference Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image models using curated hate speech prompts targeting racial, ethnic, and religious groups, measuring behavioral output safety (via VLM and human annotation for visual hatefulness), and analyzing internal latent space separability using the Alignment Quality Index (AQI).

Generating images from prompts containing gender-based slurs and stereotypes, assessing visual toxicity, and measuring structural alignment by calculating the geometric cluster separation of safe versus unsafe representations in the model's latent space.

Assessing visual outputs generated from ableist hate speech prompts through human and automated VLM evaluations, and quantifying the model's internal alignment fidelity against such prompts using the latent-space Alignment Quality Index (AQI).
